organization.name: Stirling PDF, Inc.
organization.notes: OCV primary announcement dates project origin January 2023 and commercial company launch September 2024 with $2M funding. Exact incorporation year not established; About counter values inconsistent with history, so year left null. Named investor historical, not cap-table percentage. Mixed-license product scope retained.

pricingTiers.name: Free

pricingTiers.notes: Explicit Popular label; $99/month includes 100 users, added capacity in blocks of 100. No verified annual-prepay total.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise

API and MCP operations expose document processing to connected workflows.
